Name: Axell's Basic NPC Template
Author: 7thAxis
Description:
[center][img width=750,height=204]https://i.ibb.co/v6kLpShT/Axells.png[/img][/center]
[quote][color=#D4D4D8][size=3]Hello one and all! This is a base for creating an NPC. You may use this in any way you wish, so long as [b]you read the extended permissions and adhere to them[/b]. This was made by myself with feedback from the East Scarp community in hopes of lowering the barrier to entry in NPC creation as well as provide a reference to those that need it.[/size][/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]To get started all you need to do is install SMAPI and Content Patcher. I highly advise reading through the entire template before you start editing things, as I have left extensive comments. Also be sure to check out the "Useful Resources" folder.[/color][/quote]
This base contains templates for:
[quote][list]
[*]A very basic functional NPC[/*]
[*]File Loading[/*]
[*]Manifest[/*]
[*]Content File[/*]
[*]Dialogue[/*]
[*]Dialogue Command Examples[/*]
[*]Schedules[/*]
[*]Appearance Data[/*]
[*]Dispositions[/*]
[*]Interior Map Loading[/*]
[*]Exterior Map Patch[/*]
[*]Festival placement[/*]
[*]Gift Tastes[/*]
[*]Events[/*]
[*]Configuration[/*]
[*]Dynamic tokens[/*]
[*]i18n Explanation[/*]
[*]A pack of curated useful resources [/*]
[*]My preferred methods of organization [/*]
[*]Probably more stuff I'm forgetting[/*]
[/list][/quote]
[b][size=4][font=Arial Black]⚠️READ THIS PLEASE⚠️[/font][/size][/b]
[quote][list]
[*][b][size=4][font=Arial Black]I will not help you troubleshoot the template.[/font][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][font=Arial Black]I will not explain how to use the template.[/font][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][font=Arial Black]I will not make a romantic version of this template.[/font][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][font=Arial Black]I will only fix bugs in the base template. [/font][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][font=Arial Black]If you make changes and report a bug, it will be ignored/deleted.[/font][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][font=Arial Black]I will not add more to the template. [/font][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][font=Arial Black]I purposefully added just enough for folks to learn from. [/font][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][font=Arial Black]IF YOU RELEASE A MOD PLEASE, PLEASE MOVE THE HOUSE OUT OF THE MIDDLE OF TOWN. I PUT IT THERE ON PURPOSE SO YOU NEED TO MOVE IT.[/font][/size][/b][/*]
[/list][/quote][left][/left]
[left]Thank you to DolphinIsNotAFish, Abagaianye, Chu, EnderTedi and the rest of the East Scarp community for making suggestions! The Alternate Config art and thumbnail was provided by EnderTedi. Logo was created with [url=https://textcraft.net/]Textcraft[/url]. [/left]
